liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Audience**: rare: 7 archived performances [10]
- **Best Time at Your Party**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [10]
- **Audience**: rare: 7 archived performances [10]
- **Strap on That Jammy Pac**: back after 188 archived shows (2312 days); rare: 14 archived performances [10]
- **Audience**: rare: 7 archived performances [10]

## The recordings

- **Ween2007-04-30.akg480.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 32 songs; 176 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer judges this the best recording of the show, with the most bite and the least boominess [9]
- **ween2007-04-30.hometeam.flac16**: source not stated; 29 songs; 172 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer enjoys the sound of the Peluso microphones on this recording; Reviewer says the taping quality is excellent for a Ween show, comparable to listening to a studio album [4][8]
- **ween2007-04-30.fob.flac**: source not stated; 30 songs; 174 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer enjoys the sound of the Peluso microphones on this recording [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer complains that many kids crowded the stage, but still calls it the best Ween show they've seen in North Carolina [6]
- Gene had problems with his vocal microphone during a couple of songs [2]
- Several women danced on stage during the encores [3]
- Reviewer ranks this as the best Ween show they have attended in NC [6]
- Reviewer calls it a close contest among recordings but prefers this one on their speakers [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **Ween2007-04-30.akg480.flac16**: taped by Bagger Boy; transferred by nooch; source: Akg 480s > ck63 hypers > Edirol R4 > CD [1]. Also: AKG 480 mics with CK63 hypercardioid capsules, into an Edirol R4, then to CD [1]
- **ween2007-04-30.hometeam.flac16**: taped by J.T. Lucchesi; transferred by J.T. Lucchesi; source: Peluso CEMC-6/CK21(nos/fob[11th row]/dfc/6') > Sound Devices 702 @ 24/96 [2]
- **ween2007-04-30.fob.flac**: taped by Patrick Moore; transferred by Patrick Moore; source: Schoeps mk4 (ortf)> kc5> cmc6xt> Oade D-mod UA-5> JB3 (16/44.1) [3]. Also: Taper used a borrowed UA-5 recorder, loaned by Dave Randle, and got a last-minute ticket via JTL [3]
